archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-process
archetypes.rationale: Real-process bgjob coverage depends on timing and registry branch fidelity.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the bgjob harness and reap tests for false passes. Focus on owner death, timeout cleanup, external daemon death, and the recycled-PID fixture reaching the expired terminate branch instead of the both-dead unlink path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
